projects.title: Lamborghini Senso Elemento
projects.description: This project involved interfacing an infrared proximity sensor with an Arduino Uno microcontroller to create a crash-prevention system. Using an array of BJTs as switches, the car was capable of normal RC control, until the sensor detected an object within a foot. Then, the BJTs would be shut off, stopping the car from hitting the wall. A software loop would then activate the BJTs to send power directly from the batteries to the motors, causing the car to autonomously back up and turn right, away from the object. Normal RC operation would resume after this took place.
